latest_release.name: New paper UI, detailed reports in 3:27, and 53 community fixes
latest_release.body: ## A new UI, and detailed reports in under 4 minutes The Next.js app has a new paper design that matches [gptr.dev](https://gptr.dev). Settings live in one modal with tabs for Research, MCP, Documents and Backend; a run shows a plain-language feed, and the sources margin slides in once writing starts. The previous UI is still available at `/classic`. Detailed reports now finish in **3:27 instead of 9:11**. Sections are researched in parallel, and the default writer is now `gpt-6-sol`, which starts writing within seconds instead of reasoning for close to a minute per section first. Measurements and the model comparison are in #2272. ## ⚠️ Changes to note - **Default writer model:** `SMART_LLM` is now `openai:gpt-6-sol` (was `openai:gpt-5.4`). Set `SMART_LLM` to keep the previous model. - **LLM idle timeout:** an LLM call that sends nothing for 300 seconds now fails with a clear error instead of hanging the run. Tune it with `LLM_TIMEOUT` (`0` disables it). (#2220) - **Docker:** the root `.env` is no longer copied into images. `docker compose` loads it at runtime (needs Compose 2.24+); with `docker run`, pass `--env-file .env`. If you ever pushed an image you built locally, rotate the keys that were in your `.env`. - `generate_report` now raises when every LLM attempt fails, instead of returning an empty report. (#2219) ## Also in this release - **Prebuilt Docker images** for `linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64` on GHCR: `ghcr.io/assafelovic/gpt-researcher` and `ghcr.io/assafelovic/gpt-researcher-frontend-nextjs`, tagged with the version and `latest` (#1517) - **Research observer:** an optional lifecycle observer for integrations that want structured progress events (#2232) - **MiniMax** regional providers and Flash defaults (#1924), a configurable TypeSafe base URL (#2243), and **Deploy on Render** with a `render.yaml` blueprint (#2184) - Multi-agent plan review feedback from the web UI works again, and the multi-agent writer uses `SMART_TOKEN_LIMIT` and `REASONING_EFFORT` (#2272) - Deep research honors reasoning budgets, counts retries and nested researchers in costs, and keeps cited learnings at the word limit (#2260, #2209, #2208) - MCP search no longer blocks the event loop, and the `max_tools` cap is enforced (#2262, #2263) - Configuration: `reasoning_effort` from JSON config files, `DOC_PATH` / `REPORT_SOURCE` env overrides, UTF-8 config files, and image generation settings are all honored again (#2230, #2248, #2249, #2199, #2246) - Retriever, scraper and document loader fixes across Exa, Google, Bing, Bocha, PubMed Central, arXiv, online documents and Windows text files - Retriever plugins: a community list with Keenable and Sciverse (#2176, #2225) 53 community pull requests went into this release. Thank you to everyone who contributed. **Install:** `pip install -U gpt-researcher` (0.17.0) ## What's Changed * fix(readme): point star history chart back to official star-history.com by @assafelovic in https://github.com/assafelovic/gpt-researcher/pull/2204 * docs: drop STORM references and describe current research approach by @assafelovic in https://github.com/assafelovic/gpt-researcher/pull/2205 * fix(config): preserve loaded MCP settings by @imharjot in https://github.com/assafelovic/gpt-researcher/pull/2193 * fix(config): stop sharing mutable defaults between Config instances by @assafelovic in https://github.com/assafelovic/gpt-researcher/pull/2206 * fix(ci): cap pytest below 9.2 so --forked tests stop crashing by @assafelovic in https://github.com/assafelovic/gpt-researcher/pull/2269 * docs: use a single black tile logo in the READMEs by @assafelovic in https://github.com/assafelovic/gpt-researcher/pull/2270 * New paper UI, and detailed reports in 3:27 inste
